metrics.label: Expense Ratio
metrics.description: Annual fee as a percentage of fund assets covering management and operating costs.

metrics.label: 30 Day Yield
metrics.description: Annualized income return over the past 30 days, net of fund expenses.

metrics.label: Dividend Yield
metrics.description: Annual dividends expressed as a percentage of current share price.

metrics.label: P/E Ratio
metrics.description: Price per share divided by earnings per share, reflecting investor cost per dollar of profit.
